info.prompt: Overhead view of the Battle Royale's Closing Circle mechanic: six outer tiles charring black under {inferno orange|nuclear white|blood crimson} heat distortion, safe zone contracting with {pulsing|strobing|sinuous} intensity toward the 3-radius core. The Stealth node's hidden pocket slot glows {moss-green|violet|amber} with a stashed die, its face value (5) hovering in {sans-serif|runic|circuit-board} typography as the Rhythm node's PERFECT/GOOD/MISS markers scroll toward the hit zone at 120 BPM.
